title.es: Simulación: la jornada abierta del barrio

es: Resolver una simulación de jornada abierta integrando relato, concesión con tacto, contingencias y un plan con plazo.

teaching.en: I would like to put forward a proposal for the open day: a story workshop in the square.
teaching.es: Me gustaría presentar una propuesta para la jornada abierta: un taller de relatos en la plaza.
teaching.explanationEs: Put forward a proposal ofrece la idea sin imponerla; es la apertura con tacto.

the open day: a story workshop in the square.

teaching.en: Much as I appreciate your objection, the stall can stay in the quiet corner.

teaching.explanationEs: Much as reconoce la objeción y después mantiene tu postura, sin but.

teaching.en: I was wondering whether the budget could cover a small stall.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si el presupuesto podría cubrir un puesto pequeño.
teaching.explanationEs: La pregunta indirecta con whether suena a petición, no a exigencia; el orden es afirmativo.

teaching.en: Should it rain, the volunteers will move the workshop into the hall.

teaching.explanationEs: Should + sujeto + verbo base: contingencia formal, sin if y sin -s en el verbo.

move the workshop into the hall.

teaching.en: By Friday, we will have confirmed the stall; that is the deadline.
teaching.es: Para el viernes habremos confirmado el puesto; ese es el plazo.
teaching.explanationEs: By = para esa fecha o antes; will have + participio marca lo ya cumplido en ese momento.

the stall; that is the deadline.

teaching.explanationEs: Un compromiso reparte las cesiones entre las dos partes y cierra el debate con tacto.

prompt.es: Escribe tu intervención: idea, contexto, objeción con tacto, contingencia y plazo.

answer.text: I would like to put forward a proposal for the open day: a story workshop in the square. Last year, the square had been empty for months, and many neighbours told me they missed a place to meet. A workshop with a small book stall could change that. The square belongs to all of us, and a story is the cheapest way to fill it. I understand that the budget is small, and much as I appreciate your concern, I believe we can manage. I was wondering whether the volunteers could bring the books and the chairs, so the cost would be almost nothing, and nobody would need to spend money on anything else. Should it rain, we will move the workshop into the hall. Failing that, we can shorten the morning. If everyone agrees, I will confirm the stall by Friday, and by Saturday we will have prepared the posters. Shall we agree on that? Thank you for listening, and I hope you will join us.
accepted: I would like to put forward a proposal for the open day: a story workshop in the square. The square belongs to all of us, and a story is the cheapest way to fill it. I understand that the budget is small, and much as I appreciate your concern, I believe we can manage. I was wondering whether the volunteers could bring the books and the chairs, so the cost would be almost nothing, and nobody would need to spend money on anything else. Should it rain, we will move the workshop into the hall. Failing that, we can shorten the morning. If everyone agrees, I will confirm the stall by Friday, and by Saturday we will have prepared the posters. Shall we agree on that? Thank you for listening, and I hope you will join us.

Let me put forward a proposal: a story workshop for the open day. When I was a child, the square used to be full of people, and I would love to see that again. Stories can bring neighbours together, and a simple workshop is a good way to start. Nobody needs a big stage to tell a story, only a few chairs and a little time. Fair enough, the budget is limited. Much as I would like a bigger stall, I am sure the volunteers can help, and I was wondering whether the library could lend us some books for the morning. In the event of rain, the workshop will take place in the hall. By Friday I will have confirmed the stall with the council, and the posters will be ready by Saturday. That is our deadline, and I am confident that we can meet it together. Are we all happy with this plan?

feedback.es: Una intervención completa propone con tacto, da contexto, responde a la objeción, prevé imprevistos y fija un plazo.

origin.text: Jornada abierta del barrio. Presenta tu idea, cuenta brevemente por qué la propones, responde con tacto a la objeción de que el presupuesto es pequeño y cierra con un plan, una contingencia y un plazo (el viernes). Escribe unas 150–250 palabras.
